title.narrative: OMEP-The toy libraries project: learning life through play

description.narrative: The Toy Libraries project is a high impact, cost effective, programme that gives children, their families, early ECD practitioners and early learning facilitators access to a collection of carefully selected educational and play materials, play spaces and training on how to use these toys to enhance development. The main objective of this project is to provide easily accessible quality early learning opportunities for children by establishing a toy library at their reach. Building on OMEP Kenya's previous experience for more than 10 years, this project would empower other countries to set up toy libraries and continue developing current proposals that aim to strengthen the right to play
